```python
import re

def capital_words_spaces(s):
    return re.sub(r'(?<!^)(?=[A-Z])', ' ', s)
```

I kept the earlier lookahead version rather than the team note's `(\w)([A-Z])` pattern. The note's pattern consumes the character before each capital, so runs of capitals break: `"ABC"` becomes `"A BC"` instead of `"A B C"`. The lookahead inserts a space before every capital except at position 0, so `"Python"` returns `'Python'` and `"CapitalWordsHere"` returns `'Capital Words Here'`.
